I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lambda needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
